programmes.d: In this riotous spin on the mismatched buddy movie, an uptight and by-the-book cop (Reese Witherspoon) tries to protect the gregarious widow (Sofía Vergara) of a drug boss as they race through Texas pursued by crooked cops and murderous gunmen!

Max and Page are a mother/daughter con team. Max targets wealthy men and marries them. Page then seduces them while Max "catches" her wayward husbands in the act. Then on to the next mark, posing in a variety of guises to keep one step ahead of the law.
Adam gets engaged to a waitress and has affairs with both her sisters. The lad is certainly playing the field, but in their own ways the girls seem to be getting just as much out of the deal as him.

An aging comic icon is forced to serve out a sentence doing community service for accosting an audience member. While there, the meets the daughter of a real estate mogul, and the two find inspiration in one another resulting in surprising consequences.
